text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, scopolamine transdermal system is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Padagis US LLC posted a discontinuation on 2025-11-03. Current inventory across three sites totals 254 patches with daily usage of 19.4 patches, providing approximately 13 days of supply system-wide.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows scopolamine is not listed as of 2026-10-21. Zydus Lifesciences Limited, a registered plant for scopolamine, received a VAI classification on 2024-07-19. FDA status field reads "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Our position: Supply is finite due to the Padagis discontinuation. No FDA shortage listing exists today. The ranked vendor options are not on FDA's shortage list. Procurement should proceed while inventory permits.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC as primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Baxter Healthcare Corporation as secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Ingenus Pharmaceuticals, LLC as tertiary source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to qualify Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc. as quaternary source; requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to qualify Rhodes Pharmaceuticals LLC as fifth source; requires buyer approval.
6. Pharmacy director to monitor daily burn rates at all three sites; requires pharmacy director approval.
7. P&T committee to review therapeutic alternatives if supply cannot be sustained; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending FDA shortage listing. Relying solely on current inventory without active replenishment.
